title: Second Chance module
description: A module's module.yaml: its id, its release and the versions that release provides, what it depends on, and the data it carries. docs/modules.md describes every field.

id.description: A shipped module's is one name (wine); one someone adds is namespaced (someone/directx9).

release.description: Our fixes beneath its versions: counts up, and is never written in a Wrappfile. Changing anything in the module's folder means raising it.

native.description: The Swift implementation compiled into Second Chance this module's code is; only a shipped module may name one.

versions.description: What this release provides, as a bundle constrains it with @: an engine's own version (10.0_8), or a plain number of the module's own.

preview.description: Used only where a constraint names it.

depends-on.description: Modules installed with it, with an optional constraint (wine@10).

data.description: Tables of the module's own, each a YAML file in its folder (or JSON, which YAML 1.2 reads too), read as ${data.<table>.<key>.<field>}.

assets.description: Files the module carries for builds, tests or the wrapp, in its folder.

runtime.description: Defaults for the runtime settings of the stages that use it.
